title: Let It Flow
style: rap, ambient strings, psychedelic trap, virtuosic, gentle, steady, low, ambient, slow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Not a skull-shot, not a rush, not a race to the brink
It's the rhythm of the cell, the steady, patient drink
Forget the drown-down, forget the gut-churned swell
You gotta sip the silence, let the body breathe as well
Agua in the glass, crystal clear, waiting for the thirst
You want the absorption? You gotta pace it first

[Chorus]
H2O, let it flow, never let it stay too low
Not a flooding of the river, just a steady, constant glow
Bicarb for the balance, magnesium for the fire
Molecular hydrogen, taking hydration higher
Tight water, right water, keep the cycle in the vein
Don't rush the fountain, don't ignore the rain

[Verse 2]
Check the weight, check the scale, do the math upon the floor
Thirty-five ml for every kilo, then a little more
If the color is the sunset, then you're running in the sand
But keep it pale and golden, hold the equilibrium in hand
No heavy-handed gulping, no slamming down the tide
Just a gentle, living current moving slow along the inside

[Bridge]
Add the minerals, let the charge begin to spark
Molecular wisdom in the middle of the dark
Bicarbonate buffering the ache of the day
Magnesium steady while the cells start to play
It isn't just the liquid, it's the way you let it in
From the glass to the marrow, beneath the sweating skin

[Chorus]
H2O, let it flow, never let it stay too low
Not a flooding of the river, just a steady, constant glow
Bicarb for the balance, magnesium for the fire
Molecular hydrogen, taking hydration higher
Tight water, right water, keep the cycle in the vein
Don't rush the fountain, don't ignore the rain

[Outro]
Sip it slow
Agua
Let it go where it needs to go
Just a steady, constant, living flow
Thirty-three-six
The balance holds
